image_description: A black and white photograph showing two rolls of toilet paper mounted on a wall holder. The bottom roll is in focus and features a printed label with text that appears to be gibberish or stylized non-Latin script. The top roll is slightly out of focus. The background is a textured wall.

artifact_observations.location: Label on the front-facing lower toilet paper roll
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the wrapper is nonsensical, resembling distorted Latin or Cyrillic characters without semantic meaning. This is a hallmark artifact of AI image generation where text rendering fails.

artifact_observations.location: Edge of the paper roll facing the viewer
artifact_observations.reasoning: The concentric layers of the paper roll appear slightly fused or 'melted' together rather than showing distinct, crisp edges of individual windings. The transition from the side to the face is somewhat soft.
The mechanism holding the rolls to the wall is ill-defined and geometrically ambiguous, blending into the wall and the roll itself without clear structural logic.

focus_areas: Text legibility and semantic validity on the wrapper
Sharpness and definition of the paper roll's concentric layers
Geometric plausibility of the mounting hardware
Boundary separation between the foreground rolls and the background wall
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifact. While the object geometry is largely correct, the text is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, scrutinize the 'windings' of the paper on the side of the roll; AI often struggles to render these as distinct parallel lines, often blurring them into a smooth cone. Check if the shadow cast by the top roll onto the bottom one is physically consistent with the light source.
